integrity: The proof starts from the exact published three-vertex-per-edge realization. All vertices have squared norm 3 and coordinate sum 1, while an explicit positive degree-dependent barycentric certificate places the proposed center in their convex hull. A weighted squared-distance identity then proves minimality and uniqueness of the enclosing ball. Finite graph enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite connected simple graphs with at least one edge and the standard orthonormal affine realization of their cosmological polytopes. It does not cover arbitrary projective/affine changes, disconnected graphs with isolated vertices, inradii, John ellipsoids, or complete pairwise metric data. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent projectively phrased observation in physics-oriented notes.
title: Every connected cosmological polytope has graph-independent Euclidean circumradius
